paragraphs: Rav Yaakov, son of the daughter of Rav Acha bar Yaakov.

[Sotah 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.49a.11) relates that his grandfather Rav Acha bar Yaakov raised him. Once his grandfather asked him for water; he replied, “I am not your son.” Hence the saying, “Raise, raise—I'm your daughter's son.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sotah calls Yaakov the son of Rav Acha bar Yaakov’s daughter. His grandfather asks for water, and Yaakov responds that he is his daughter’s son.
